name: Lightning Decision Jam (Framing)
deliverable: Rapid identification and re-framing of key operational blockers

steps.text: Set the timer and have everyone silently write the blockers they hit, one per note.
Dot-vote the blockers and keep the top three.
Reframe each kept blocker as a How Might We, then vote and carry the best reframe forward.

failure: The room votes on blockers but never reframes them, so the session ends with the same complaints.
intervention: Take the top blocker, ask what opportunity hides in it, and make the room solve that question instead.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Developed by AJ&Smart as a rapid workshop format; no single canonical publication.
